name: Bas Jacobs
detail: Argues for an accrual-based capital gains tax (box 2/3 reform) and against heavier wealth taxation; not a wealth tax supporter.

name: Marijnissen motion 2022D01609 (SP)
detail: Asks only for measures to reduce wealth inequality; no wealth tax named.

name: Nijboer/Maatoug motion 2022D29254
detail: Raises box 3 rates; reform of the savings-and-investment box, not a wealth tax design.

name: Stultiens/Teunissen amendment 2026D05106
detail: Property accrual tax inside the box 3 reform for everyone; capital gains design.

name: Idsinga/Van Eijk motion 2024D13521
detail: Global minimum tax on hypermobile wealthy individuals; unclear that it taxes wealth.

name: Individual MPs inferred from parliamentary group votes
detail: Party-level hand votes on 36600-17 and 36202-102 are not individual roll calls; do not infer each member endorsed the tax.

name: Folkert Idsinga and Wendy van Eijk: motion 25087-333 alone
detail: International minimum taxation of hypermobile wealthy individuals does not itself specify a wealth-stock basis; seek explicit design evidence before inclusion.
